item.title: Winter Fury Continues: Fog, cold wave disrupt life in several states; Check weather report here
item.description: North India continues to battle severe cold and dense fog, severely impacting daily life and transportation. Extremely low visibility led to multiple road accidents across Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and other states, claiming several lives and injuring dozens.

item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Monday 19 January In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Monday, 19 January- politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Gold prices slip on first day of the week; Silver also sees decline
item.description: Gold prices edged lower at the start of the new week in the domestic market, bringing mild relief to buyers. Despite the dip, gold has posted strong weekly gains. Silver prices also declined, though the metal remains significantly higher on a year-to-date basis.

item.title: High-speed trains crash in Spain; 20 Killed, over 70 injured
item.description: A devastating train accident occurred in southern Spain when two high-speed trains collided near Córdoba’s Adamuz area. At least 20 people lost their lives, while over 73 passengers sustained injuries, many of them critical.

item.title: Inside Trump’s Board of Peace: Why India is invited and what it aims to do; Full details here
item.description: US President Donald Trump has announced the formation of an international “Board of Peace” to oversee governance, reconstruction, and stability in post-war Gaza. India has been invited to join the initiative alongside several other countries.

item.title: Indian Stock Market opens lower amid weak global cues; Sensex, Nifty slip in early trade
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened lower on Monday amid weak market sentiment and cautious investor outlook. The Sensex slipped over 470 points in early trade, while the Nifty 50 declined more than 135 points.

item.title: Iran President warns US; Says aggression against Khamenei means full-scale war
item.description: Amid widespread unrest in Iran, President Masoud Pezeshkian has issued a strong warning to the United States, stating that any aggression against Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei would trigger an all-out war.

item.title: UAE President to visit India today; Key talks with PM Modi on multiple issues
item.description: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan is visiting India for high-level talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi aimed at strengthening the comprehensive strategic partnership. Discussions are expected to focus on trade, investment, defence cooperation, energy initiatives and regional developments in West Asia.

item.title: Delhi Police issues high alert ahead of Republic Day; Posters of wanted terrorists displayed
item.description: Ahead of India’s 77th Republic Day, Delhi Police has issued a high alert across the capital. Posters of wanted terrorists from banned groups like Babbar Khalsa International, Jaish-e-Mohammed, Al-Qaeda, and KTF have been displayed at crowded markets, railway stations, and metro hubs.

item.title: ICC issues final warning to Bangladesh Cricket Board over T20 World Cup; Sets deadline
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has given Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) a strict ultimatum to decide participation in the T20 World Cup 2026 by January 21. BCB cited security concerns in India and requested alternate venues, including Sri Lanka, which ICC rejected.
